description: The R4/R6-style leak census: the agent's eight common prompts sent with 2, 14, 60 or all 21 of the real agent tools, at chosen temperatures, streaming and not. A leak is a tool call written as text instead of returned as a structured call. The tool list is the real one from core (frozen in fixtures/agent-tools.json, regenerate with `lab.mjs snapshot-tools`); the 60-tool set pads it with plain synthetic tools. The default grid is small; --full-grid runs every combination.
system: You are a coding agent working in a repository. When a task needs a tool, call the tool; do not describe the call in prose.

prompts.text: Read the file src/main.ts and tell me what it exports.
Run `grep -r TODO src` and show me the matches.
Run the test suite with `npm test`; it is slow, so let it wait for completion.
Find every TypeScript test file under packages/.
List the files in the docs directory, recursively.
Create notes/todo.md containing a three-item checklist about releasing v1.2.
Plan a refactor of the login module into three steps, then present the plan for approval.
Fetch https://example.com/changelog and summarise the latest entry.
